title: Tests share a fixed books.db in the cwd and rely on tearDown cleanup
evidence: app.py:8 DB_FILE='books.db' (module-level, cwd); test_app.py:13 setUp calls init_db() without removing a pre-existing file, test_app.py:19 tearDown removes it. A books.db left by a crashed prior run would leak rows into the first test.
suggestion: Use a temp/isolated DB per test (tempfile or :memory:) or unlink books.db in setUp before init_db().
